OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ENCHANTMENT_KNOCKBA:
When this Attack deals damage, deal half that damage as [gold]knockback damage[/gold] to the next enemy behind the target. If there is no enemy behind it, the target takes the damage.
[gold]Knockback damage[/gold] ignores all modifiers.
If an enemy takes more than half its Max HP as knockback damage during one card resolution, [gold]Stun[/gold] it.
Giant enemies cannot be pushed or trigger collisions.
